HANDOFF 2026-11-19 20:00 KST, office track/agent-v2 lead (session key possum-clay-halved, epic 261114-epic-ws-common-session-foundation). The owner is away 3 days and resumes from home. track/agent-v2 is pushed to origin. Every impl branch from today is merged; no in-flight impl/track/agent-v2/* branch remains. The develop merge-back still waits for explicit owner approval (last approved: 5981d2e41). The origin URL still points to kang-sw/devenv (GitHub redirects to kang-sw/werkschaft).

LANDED TODAY on track/agent-v2 (all pushed):
- 49b2f3184: harness verified versions. Claude 2.1.322..2.1.327, Codex 0.160.0..0.170.0, agy 1.5.9..1.5.12. T0.
- 9dc9862b0: transcript memory-first Phase 2 (261118-feat-ws-display-transcript-memory-first).
  - Pinned per-HostedSlot ring segments, one Write per append.
  - The in-memory registration fence was reverted to OS flock.
  - T1. Review R1 FIX, R2 FIX, R3 MERGE.
  - Forward: unlink retry, O(2000) slice copy at cap, MkdirAll per rotation, Phase 3 record.json delta log.
- d6a7d74b2: hosted compaction lifecycle Phase 1 (261117-feat-ws-hosted-compaction-lifecycle).
  - ws/compact delivers native compaction through descriptor facts.
  - Per-harness detection drives the compacting badge and a one-shot restore note.
  - 50%/80% nudges; a 10m watchdog stops a stalled process.
  - T0. Review R1, R2, R3 MERGE.
  - Forward: config.list/tune echo for compaction.*; workers lack agenda.list before Phase 2; composeLeadInstructions wording when PromptPersists is false; Codex compaction probe (mcp_servers.ws override failure).
- 9913eaac6: agy ws/compact ((204)=a).
  - Detection is a usage_update drop: same window, below 85% of the previous count, and at least 2000 tokens. ACP has no signal; agy hooks are global-only.
  - A cancelled /compact counts as failed. T0.
- 2605e2745: peer mail shown 3x in the recipient view. Display-only: a [relation:] line broke linkMailWakes pairing.
- cb363b321: dashboard shell topbar/rail redesign Phase 1 (peer lead AGY-5). Ticket closed.
  - Forward: framed 1920px scroll test, >=2200px pinned/overlay test, re-verify 3 browser tests once the 17 baseline wsdashboard failures clear.
- 3a8ea336e: (203)=a harness-neutral 'background' state.
  - agy tracks unfinished run_command toolCallIds across end_turn; bounded wakeup turns close after usage_update plus 1.5 s quiet, with a 30 s fallback.
  - holdsReport withholds 'turn done' while bgTasks > 0, plus a 6 s grace.
  - AgentStatus 'background'; badge.
  - T1. Review R1 FIX x2, then MERGE.
  - Branch merge 905aa2010 resolved 6 conflicts with compaction P1; w5090 green.
  - Forward: an agy turn silent more than 30 s right after --replace closes early.
  - The resolution itself had no separate review (time); consider a quick review at home.

PAUSED: tickets/agent-v2/pdg-promote 4c815d9df (AGY-5), 261119-feat-ws-dashboard-paged-docking-gallery in todo/.
- Owner answers (13) and (14) are needed; they are on the AGY-5 board, topic pdg-promote.
- Then: apply the edits, large delta design review, sage_stamp combined, move to ready, merge.

DAEMON SWAP: NOT done today. The office daemon is an old build, so all of the above is live only after a swap.
- Procedure: from the root worktree in PowerShell, rebuild PATH from the Machine and User registry, then `python scripts\dev.py rerun daemon`. If it reports 'none running', run it once more.
- Do it with no children running; a swap interrupts running children.
- After the swap, check:
  - a fresh agy worker sees underscore tool names with full parameters;
  - a long command shows 'background' and the worker does not report done early;
  - /compact on agy shows the badge.
  - Then the owner-PC syscall/AV measurement for transcript P2.
- Once the background state is verified live, drop the interim agy brief rule 'do not end the turn mid-command'.

OPEN OWNER ITEMS:
- (206) on this session's board: ring_store.go is 1,212 lines, over the size advisory. Recommended: split it in transcript Phase 3. compaction_test.go (1,064), rail.js (1,048) and runner_events.go (1,020) also crossed 1,000; same treatment.
- The custom-tier discussion (261119-feat-ws-named-custom-tiers, todo).

NEXT CANDIDATES: 261116-feat-ws-subagent-worktree-lease (ready) on agy.large; compaction Phase 2 (new-session segment chain, worker restore bundle); transcript Phase 3; promote the dogfood surprises to a ready ticket. Dogfood surprises: the render-minted key refusal; the stale pi.* owner-preference text; tickets.query output over the size limit; Codex git_commit 'branch mismatch'; the legacy 'Reply with pi.send' notice prefix; mail after a swap not waking agy; agy playbook.render drift; agy workers ending turns mid-command (fixed by 3a8ea336e, pending a live check).

RULES that still hold:
- No Pi work; every subagent is agy-tier through agent.spawn, with authority capped at workdir-write.
- Go tests on w5090 only; no local go test or ws test executables on the office PC.
- Pi/GPT/agy commits carry no Co-Authored-By trailer.
- Push track/agent-v2 after each merge.

The older note handoff-agy-switch-20261118 is superseded by this one; erase it.
